subject: English
passage: The Bronze Age Collapse was a period of widespread societal breakdown around 1200-1150 BCE in the Eastern Mediterranean. Some archaeologists argue that massive earthquakes triggered the collapse. Others disagree, partly because there is no confirmed seismic evidence from sites that dates to the beginning of the period. In 2018, a team led by Lina Chami discovered extensive earthquake damage at an ancient city in Turkey. The archaeologists who believe earthquakes caused the Bronze Age Collapse claim that this discovery supports their view. However, Chami's team hasn't yet been able to determine the date of the earthquake damage. Therefore, the team suggests that ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: it can't be concluded that the earthquake that caused the damage was connected to the beginning of the Bronze Age Collapse.
choices.B: it can't be determined whether earthquakes could cause damage as extensive as what was found at the site.
choices.C: archaeologists have ignored the possibility that something other than earthquakes could have caused the damage.
choices.D: the archaeologists who believe earthquakes caused the Bronze Age Collapse have made incorrect assumptions about when the period began.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of earthquake damage and its connection to the start of the Bronze Age Collapse. According to the text, some archaeologists believe that massive earthquakes triggered the Bronze Age Collapse period. The text then indicates that a team of archaeologists found earthquake damage in Turkey, which some believe supports the theory of earthquakes triggering the Bronze Age Collapse. However, the text also notes that the team was unable to determine the date of the earthquake damage. If the date of the earthquake damage can't be determined, then its connection to the Bronze Age Collapse period can't be confirmed either. Thus, it can't be concluded that the earthquake that caused the damage was connected to the beginning of the Bronze Age Collapse.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect because though the text suggests that the date of the earthquake damage found by a team of archaeologists is uncertain, it doesn't address whether earthquakes can cause damage as extensive as what was discovered. The text doesn't consider the magnitude of earthquakes and how they relate to the extent of damage they might cause.
